basic_info.description:
Welcome to 720 Gough, Unit 58! This bright, spacious, rare find in Hayes Valley has a sunny disposition across 1,200 square feet of beautiful Brazilian cherrywood floors and 12 foot-ceilings. With two large master suites, ample closet space, and patio access from each bedroom, this unit offers enough space to live comfortably and entertain easily. The kitchen, living, and dining room have an open space design. With in-unit washer-dryer and dishwasher, this sun-drenched unit was beautifully renovated with thoughtful touches and an elegant design, with a direct and beautiful view of San Francisco's City Hall. Great for professionals or families. Dedicated parking included with rent.
 
Vibrant neighborhood some of SF's best restaurants are just three blocks away, on Hayes Street, as are artsy boutiques, cute sidewalk cafes, and packed bars where the rest of the City comes to play. 720 Gough is also two blocks from Civic Center - the hub of the arts, with the SF symphony, ballet, opera, concert hall, annual festivals, and a bi-weekly farmer's market within walking distance. Last but not least, 720 Gough also offers quick access to Bart and the Bay Bridge and the South Bay and is well-served by Muni.
